name: Raise a referral at the front door
does: Logs a brand-new referral, addressed to as many as three places at once, every one of them starting unanswered.
needs: Nothing before it — this is where a journey begins. Every field is checked at the door.
changes: Creates the referral with every destination set to waiting.

refuses.message: RECEIVE_REFERRAL needs at least one destination
RECEIVE_REFERRAL may address at most ${cap} destinations, not ${n}
RECEIVE_REFERRAL cannot address the same destination kind twice

refuses.when: An ED that does not exist
refuses.message: RECEIVE_REFERRAL edId must resolve to a real emergency department

refuses.when: Someone in an ED claiming another source
refuses.message: RECEIVE_REFERRAL raised as role ed must carry source ed_medical, not ${source}

refuses.when: An ED referral from a site with no ED
refuses.message: RECEIVE_REFERRAL source ed_medical requires an origin site with an emergency department

refuses.when: A triage time later than the referral
refuses.message: RECEIVE_REFERRAL triagedAt cannot be later than the referral itself
RECEIVE_REFERRAL patientId must name a patient this system already holds, and ${id} names none
RECEIVE_REFERRAL ${field} is ${n} characters and the limit is ${limit} — it is refused rather than shortened
RECEIVE_REFERRAL sendingTeamName is present but blank — omit the field to record no sending team

name: Add a person who is not on file
does: Registers somebody with no referral, movement or bed record yet — the “searched, nobody came up, so add them” record.
needs: Nothing.
changes: Creates a new patient record.

refuses.message: ADD_PATIENT gender must be chosen from GENDERS

name: Record whether they are medically cleared
does: Records, or changes, whether a patient in the front-door queue is medically cleared right now.
needs: The referral exists. Overwriting an earlier answer is deliberate.
changes: Sets or replaces the clearance answer and its time.

refuses.message: no referral found for id ${referralId}

name: Mark that an expected patient has turned up
does: Marks that a patient the department was expecting has physically arrived.
needs: The referral exists. Recording it twice is harmless — the earliest time is kept.
changes: Stamps the arrival time, once.

refuses.message: no referral found for id ${referralId}

name: Accept the referral
does: A ward, emergency department or community team says yes to the destination addressed to it. The first yes automatically cancels every other destination still waiting — except a community arm, which never competes for the bed.
needs: The destination was actually addressed to you, is still waiting, and the referral has not been withdrawn or accepted elsewhere.
changes: Marks that destination accepted, cancels the other waiting non-community destinations, notifies the referrer and the receiving ward. No bed is pulled and no movement is created.

refuses.when: The referral already has a movement under way
refuses.message: referral ${id} already has an open movement (${movementId}); it cannot also be accepted into a ward while that movement is open

refuses.when: Answering for somebody else's kind of destination
refuses.message: was raised by role ${role}, which may only answer ${ownKind} destinations, not ${kind}
referral ${id} was not addressed to ${kind}
referral ${id} has already been accepted elsewhere
${kind} has already answered referral ${id} (${state})
referral ${id} was withdrawn by its referrer, so ${kind} cannot accept it

refuses.when: A ward accepting without naming a unit
refuses.message: ACCEPT_REFERRAL into a psychiatric ward must name a unit

refuses.when: A non-binary placement nobody has cleared
refuses.message: This patient is recorded as non-binary. A coordinator must record a reason after checking with the ward before this placement.

refuses.when: A team being asked to name a bed
refuses.message: ${kind} is answered by a team, not a bed — it cannot name a unit
(the eligibility check supplies its own sentence — sex, gender, cohort, security, legal status, acuity or capacity)

name: Decline the referral
does: Says no to the destination addressed to you. Nothing else on the referral changes, and the other places asked carry on.
needs: The destination was addressed to you and is still waiting.
changes: Marks that one destination declined with its reason, and tells the referrer.

refuses.when: A reason from the wrong list
refuses.message: DECLINE_REFERRAL reason must be chosen from ${listName}, the vocabulary for ${kind} destinations
referral ${id} has already been accepted elsewhere
referral ${id} was withdrawn by its referrer, so ${kind} cannot decline it

name: The referrer takes the referral back
does: The referring party withdraws — either just the community half, leaving the bed request standing, or the whole referral, which also gives back any held bed and cancels any transport.
needs: Nothing has been accepted yet, and it has not already been withdrawn.
changes: Stamps the withdrawal on every still-waiting destination; closes any linked open movement as “did not proceed”.

refuses.message: referral ${id} has already been accepted, so it cannot be withdrawn
referral ${id} has already been recorded as withdrawn by its referrer
every destination on referral ${id} has already answered

refuses.when: Transport has already collected the patient
refuses.message: referral ${id} is linked to movement ${mid}, whose transport has already been collected; this needs a coordinator decision (see STOP_TRANSPORT) rather than an automatic withdrawal

refuses.when: Withdrawing the community arm with no reason
refuses.message: RECORD_REFERRER_WITHDRAWAL scoped to community_team must give a reason from WARD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL_REASONS

name: Add a correction to a referral
does: Adds a dated, attributed note correcting something on a referral, at any point in its life. What was said before stays readable.
needs: The referral exists. No stage condition at all.
changes: Appends the note. Never overwrites.

refuses.message: ADD_REFERRAL_CORRECTION note must say something — a blank is not a correction
ADD_REFERRAL_CORRECTION note is ${n} characters and the limit is ${limit} — it is refused rather than shortened

name: Record that a bed closer to home was looked for
does: Records that somebody looked for a bed nearer the person's home before sending them further. It never gates an acceptance — it exists so the search can be shown to have happened.
needs: The referral is still undecided.
changes: Stamps the search and who did it.

refuses.message: referral ${id} was already decided (${state})
referral ${id} already records a local bed search

screen.control: Record that a local bed was sought and none was suitable

name: Start a bed search from a department
does: Opens the record that actually moves — a department's own bed search for a patient in front of them, optionally linked back to the community referral that sent them there.
needs: A real department. If linking a referral: it exists, was addressed here, is not withdrawn, was not declined here, and has no other open movement.
changes: Creates the movement at the first stage, capturing any legal form and expiry typed in.

refuses.message: RAISE_REFERRAL referralId must name a referral this system already holds, and ${id} names none
referral ${id} was never addressed to ${name}, so a journey raised there did not come from it
referral ${id} was withdrawn by its referrer, so no journey can be raised from it
${name} declined referral ${id}, so no journey can be raised from it

refuses.when: It is already funding an open journey
refuses.message: referral ${id} already has a linked movement that did not close as “did not proceed”; a second journey cannot be raised while it stands

name: Ask one or more wards
does: Asks wards to consider the patient — one, or several at once up to the cap. Asking more later adds to the same request.
needs: The record is still at one of the two stages where wards can be asked. Once somebody has accepted, you cannot go on asking.
changes: Adds those wards to the live list and moves the record to destination review.

refuses.message: cannot refer to ${n} units at once — the parallel cap is ${cap}
cannot refer a movement at its current stage (${stage})

refuses.when: A ward that does not exist
refuses.message: no unit found for id ${id}

refuses.when: A non-binary placement with no recorded check
refuses.message: This patient is recorded as non-binary. A coordinator must record a reason after checking with the ward before this placement.
(the whole request is refused when no ward on it can take the patient)

name: A ward accepts in principle
does: A ward formally accepts the patient and becomes the destination. Every other ward asked is withdrawn automatically. Still no bed is set aside.
needs: The record is at destination review and this ward holds a live request.
changes: Records the accepting ward, clears every other live request, and tells the referring department.

refuses.message: movement ${id} is already accepted at ${unit}; the referral to ${other} was withdrawn
cannot accept a movement at its current stage (${stage})
${unitId} does not hold a live referral for movement ${id}

refuses.when: A non-binary placement with no recorded check
refuses.message: This patient is recorded as non-binary. A coordinator must record a reason after checking with the ward before this placement.

name: A ward declines the bed search
does: A ward asked for a bed says no, with a reason. The patient stays live at every other ward still considering.
needs: The record is at destination review and this ward holds a live request.
changes: Removes that ward from the list and records the decline. The stage does not move.

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: DECLINE reason must be chosen from DECLINE_REASONS
cannot decline at the movement's current stage (${stage})
${unitId} does not hold a live referral for movement ${id}

name: Take back one ward's request
does: Withdraws the request from one named ward only. Every other ward asked carries on considering.
needs: That ward holds a live request.
changes: Removes that one ward and tells it why.

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: WITHDRAW_WARD_REQUEST reason must be chosen from WARD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL_REASONS
${unitId} does not hold a live referral for movement ${id}

name: Undo a ward's acceptance
does: Undoes a ward's yes before any bed has been taken, sends the search back to asking wards, and tells that ward its acceptance no longer stands.
needs: The record is at “accepted, awaiting bed” — this one step and nowhere later — and no bed is held.
changes: Clears the accepting ward and returns to destination review. The ward is deliberately not re-added to the asked list.

refuses.message: cannot withdraw an acceptance unless the movement is still awaiting a bed (movement ${id} is at ${stage})
cannot withdraw an acceptance while movement ${id} still holds a bed (admission ${aid}); pull it again to restore it, release the pull, then withdraw

name: Abandon the bed search
does: Cancels the search outright — either pulling it from every ward still being asked, or, once accepted, revoking the acceptance and giving back any held bed.
needs: The record is open. Once accepted, only the referrer or the coordinator may do it, and only before the patient is collected.
changes: Closes the movement as “did not proceed”, releases any held bed, cancels any live transport.

refuses.when: Already accepted, and you are not the referrer or coordinator
refuses.message: movement ${id} has already been accepted by ${unit}; only the referrer or the coordinator may revoke it now

refuses.when: The patient is already in the vehicle
refuses.message: movement ${id}'s patient has already been collected; use STOP_TRANSPORT to stop the journey instead of withdrawing the referral
movement ${id} holds no live referral to withdraw
has already closed and cannot be withdrawn

name: Send them to a community team instead
does: Instead of admitting, refers the patient straight to a named community team — ends the bed search, creates or reuses a real community referral, and tells everybody involved.
needs: The record is open and transport has not collected the patient. If they are on a legal form, a conclusive examination outcome must already be recorded.
changes: Gives back any held bed, cancels transport, withdraws live ward requests, closes the movement, and raises or reuses the community arm.

refuses.message: team “${team}” is not a valid community mental health team

refuses.when: The patient is already in the vehicle
refuses.message: movement ${id}'s patient has already been collected; use STOP_TRANSPORT to stop the journey instead of referring to a community team

refuses.when: On a form with no conclusive examination
refuses.message: movement ${id} is on a legal form; a conclusive examination outcome must be recorded before referring to a community team
cannot refer a closed movement

name: The department decides they need no bed
does: Records that the patient no longer needs a psychiatric bed — going home, or to community follow-up — and unwinds everything already in motion.
needs: The record is open and transport has not collected the patient. For “for discharge” on a legal form, a conclusive examination outcome must already be recorded.
changes: Releases a held bed, cancels an uncollected transport job, drops live ward requests, closes the movement, and notifies every ward affected.

refuses.when: The patient is already in the vehicle
refuses.message: movement ${id}'s patient has already been collected; use STOP_TRANSPORT to stop the journey instead of recording an ED outcome

refuses.when: Discharging somebody on a form with no conclusive examination
refuses.message: movement ${id} is on a legal form; a conclusive examination outcome must be recorded before recording “for discharge”
cannot record an ED outcome for a closed movement

name: Record that nobody referred them
does: Records that, on checking, nobody actually referred this patient in.
needs: The record is open and is not already linked to a referral.
changes: Stamps the absence and its reason.

refuses.when: It already came from a referral
refuses.message: movement ${id} was raised from referral ${rid}, so it cannot also record that nobody referred this patient
cannot record a referral answer for a closed movement

name: Record an escalation
does: Records that the search was escalated — which wards were tried, and who was contacted.
needs: The record is open.
changes: Stamps the escalation, the wards tried and the contact.

refuses.message: cannot escalate a closed movement (${reason})

name: Correct the record backwards
does: Moves the record back to an earlier point. A pure record correction — it deliberately releases no bed and cancels no transport.
needs: The target is strictly earlier than where it is now, and the patient has not arrived.
changes: Moves the stage and logs the correction. Nothing else is touched at all.

refuses.message: cannot step back an arrived movement (invariant I-05: physical arrival is irreversible)
STEP_BACK_STAGE target must be strictly before the movement's current stage

name: Take the bed
does: The ward claims the bed it accepted, and an admission record is created marked held — not occupied. A patient is not arrived until the ward says they have arrived.
needs: The record is at “accepted, awaiting bed” and this is the ward that accepted.
changes: Takes one allocatable bed, creates the held admission, and starts the four-hour hold.

refuses.message: no allocatable bed remains at ${unit} (the ward's allocatable count is ${n})

refuses.when: Every free bed is still being made ready
refuses.message: every free bed at ${unit} is still being made ready (${n} pending); a patient cannot be pulled to a bed that is not open
${unit} has no one-to-one specialling capacity left; this patient needs specialling and the ward cannot staff another
This placement needs an override reason and the nurse unit manager consulted.
No locked bed is free at ${unit}. This placement needs an override reason to use an open bed.
movement ${id} was accepted at ${other}, not ${unitId}

name: Give the held bed back
does: A ward gives back a bed it was holding before the patient arrived. The admission record is deleted outright — nobody was ever in this bed.
needs: The bed is currently held. A ward may only release its own.
changes: Returns the bed to the ward, deletes the admission, sends the record back to “accepted, awaiting bed”, and tells the department.

refuses.message: cannot release a pull at the movement's current stage (${stage})
RELEASE_PULL was raised acting as unit ${id} but movement ${mid}'s bed is pulled at ${other}

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: RELEASE_PULL reason must be chosen from RELEASE_PULL_REASONS

name: Release a bed left held by a stopped journey
does: Releases the bed that stopping a transport deliberately left held, once it is decided the patient is not coming after all. The only way to give that bed back.
needs: The journey was stopped after collection, and a bed is still held.
changes: Releases the bed and deletes the admission.

refuses.when: It was not stopped that way
refuses.message: movement ${id} was not stopped by STOP_TRANSPORT, so there is no held bed to release this way
movement ${id} holds no bed — it may already have been released

refuses.when: Acting as a ward that does not hold the bed
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the bed is held at another

name: Record whether transport is needed
does: Records whether the patient will need help getting to the ward. Answering “no” is what lets them be marked arrived with no journey at all.
needs: The record is open. Changing the answer later is deliberate.
changes: Sets or replaces the answer.

refuses.message: cannot record a transport need for a closed movement (${reason})

name: Book the transport
does: Logs a transport booking already made by phone: who is taking them, whether an escort is needed, the CAD number, whether the transport is voluntary or involuntary, and an estimated time.
needs: A bed is held or handover is ready, and no job is booked already.
changes: Creates the transport job and records who booked it — which decides who may later cancel it.

refuses.message: BOOK_TRANSPORT escortRequired must be answered, and it has no default
BOOK_TRANSPORT cadNumber must be answered, and it has no default
BOOK_TRANSPORT estimatedAt must be answered, and it has no default
transport for movement ${id} is already booked
cannot book transport at the movement's current stage (${stage})

refuses.when: A ward booking without saying which ward it is
refuses.message: BOOK_TRANSPORT raised as ward must state its actingUnitId, and it has no default

name: Confirm handover is ready
does: Confirms the patient is ready for the booked crew to collect.
needs: A bed is held and either a transport job exists or the ward recorded that transport is not needed.
changes: Moves the record to handover ready.

refuses.message: cannot ready a handover before transport is booked (BOOK_TRANSPORT)
cannot ready a handover at the movement's current stage (${stage})

name: The crew accepts the job
does: Records that the transport provider has accepted the collection job.
needs: Handover is ready and the job has not already been accepted.
changes: Stamps the acceptance.

refuses.message: transport for movement ${id} was already accepted

name: The crew sets off
does: Records that the vehicle has set off towards the patient. Nothing here checks whether the legal authority still stands.
needs: The job has been accepted and is not already en route.
changes: Stamps the departure.

refuses.message: transport for movement ${id} is already en route
cannot mark transport en route: the movement must be at handover ready with transport accepted

name: The patient is picked up
does: Records that the patient has physically been collected and the journey has begun. After this, cancelling is no longer possible — only stopping.
needs: The vehicle is en route, and the legal authority has not been revoked while a bed is still held.
changes: Moves the record to moving and stamps the collection.

refuses.when: The examination was revoked and a bed is still held
refuses.message: cannot collect a patient for movement ${id}: the examination was revoked and this movement still holds a bed — a person must release the bed or record a repeat examination first
cannot collect a patient: the movement must be at handover ready with transport en route

name: The ward says they have arrived
does: The ward confirms the patient is physically here and now occupies the bed. The one step that can never be undone. Where no transport was needed, it can be said straight from a held bed.
needs: Either the patient has been collected, or no transport was ever needed and a bed is held. A ward must say which ward it is.
changes: Uses up a physically empty bed, flips the held admission to occupied, and closes the movement as arrived.

refuses.message: no physically empty bed remains at ${unit} (no_bed)

refuses.when: A ward confirming somebody else's patient
refuses.message: ward ${id} cannot confirm arrival for a patient accepted at ${other}

refuses.when: No transport needed, but no bed held yet
refuses.message: cannot arrive a patient with no transport needed at the movement's current stage; the bed must be pulled first

name: Cancel the transport before collection
does: Cancels a booked job before the vehicle has picked the patient up. Only whoever booked it (or the coordinator or department) may do this, and nothing is rebooked for you.
needs: A job exists and the patient has not been collected or arrived.
changes: Deletes the job entirely. The stage does not move and the bed stays held.

refuses.message: cannot cancel transport for movement ${id} — the patient has departed
cannot cancel transport for movement ${id} — the patient has arrived

refuses.when: A ward cancelling a job it did not book
refuses.message: CANCEL_TRANSPORT raised as ward acting as ${id} may only cancel transport it booked for movement ${mid}

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: CANCEL_TRANSPORT reason must be chosen from CANCEL_TRANSPORT_REASONS

refuses.when: A community team cancelling a job it did not book
refuses.message: may only cancel transport it booked

name: Stop the journey after collection
does: Stops a journey with the patient already in the vehicle. Somebody must say where the patient now is. The movement closes and the bed deliberately stays held.
needs: The patient has been collected, and has not arrived or already been stopped.
changes: Stamps the stop, its reason and the whereabouts; closes the movement; leaves the bed held until it is separately released.

refuses.message: movement ${id}'s transport has not been collected yet; use CANCEL_TRANSPORT instead
movement ${id}'s patient has already arrived
STOP_TRANSPORT whereabouts must be chosen from TRANSPORT_WHEREABOUTS

name: Record that they have left the department
does: Records the time the patient physically left the emergency department.
needs: An outcome has already been recorded, and this has not been recorded before.
changes: Stamps the departure time.

refuses.message: movement ${id} has no ed outcome recorded; record an outcome before marking left department

name: Record an examination outcome
does: Records what an examination found. An inpatient order or a further examination just notes the fact. A community order or a revocation ends the bed search — but only if transport is not already committed. Once it is, the bed is deliberately NOT released: a flag is raised and a person must act.
needs: The record is open. A second examination is only allowed if the last one ordered a further examination.
changes: An inpatient order or further examination records the outcome only. A community order or revocation before committed transport releases the bed, cancels transport and closes the movement; after commitment it records the outcome and sets a blocker for a coordinator to resolve.

refuses.message: movement ${id} was already examined
cannot record an examination for a closed movement (${reason})

name: Change the legal status
does: Changes the patient's status under the Mental Health Act, recording who changed it and why. It never reacts on its own — even if this makes an already-accepted bed unlawful, that only surfaces for a human to look at.
needs: The record is open.
changes: Sets the status and logs the change.

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: CHANGE_LEGAL_STATUS reason must be chosen from LEGAL_STATUS_CHANGE_REASONS
cannot change legal status for a closed movement

name: Mark a form as physically received
does: Marks that a patient's legal form has physically arrived. Any of the nine forms with a legal clock (1A, 3A, 3C, 3D, 5A, 5B, 6A, 6B, 6C) can be marked, not only Form 1A (owner ruling D-16).
needs: The record carries one of those nine forms and has not been marked already.
changes: Stamps the receipt.

refuses.message: legal form for movement ${id} was already marked as received

refuses.when: Not one of the nine receivable forms
refuses.message: movement ${id} does not carry a receivable legal form (legal form ${code}), so a legal form receipt cannot be recorded against it
cannot mark legal form received for a closed movement (${reason})

screen.control: Mark Form 1A received (the legal forms screen marks the other eight)

name: Undo a form receipt
does: Undoes a receipt logged by mistake, keeping a record that a correction happened and why.
needs: There is a receipt to correct.
changes: Clears the receipt and appends the correction.

refuses.message: movement ${id} has no recorded legal form receipt to correct
cannot correct a legal form receipt for a closed movement

name: Record or extend a form's expiry
does: Records the expiry written on the form, or an extension written on a fresh one. Every date here is typed by a clinician — nothing is computed and no Act section numbers appear anywhere.
needs: The record carries a legal form. An extension must be strictly later than the expiry already there.
changes: Sets the expiry and appends it to the history.

refuses.message: There is no legal form on this record to add an expiry to.
Enter the expiry written on the form.

refuses.when: An extension that is not later
refuses.message: An extension's new expiry must be later than the expiry already recorded.

name: Correct the recorded gender
does: Corrects the gender recorded on an open record and, if a ward already holds or has accepted the bed, tells the coordinator to check the placement still suits.
needs: The record is open and the new value differs from what is there.
changes: Sets the gender, logs the change, and raises a notice where a bed is involved.

refuses.message: movement ${id} is already recorded as gender ${gender}
cannot record gender for a closed movement

name: Record that the patient has left
does: Records that an admitted patient has physically left the ward, ending their stay. One of the eight destinations frees no bed statewide at all.
needs: They are currently occupying a bed and not in active transit. Only the ward they are on may record it; an involuntary patient cannot leave to the community or against advice.
changes: Ends the admission and raises the ward's empty and allocatable counts by one (only the timestamps move if this person's release had already been completed), gives back a locked bed, adjusts the sex mix, ends any leave bed, and completes this person's pending bed release.

refuses.message: admission ${id} has already left
admission ${id} is ${state}, and only somebody occupying a bed can leave one
RECORD_LEAVING was raised acting as unit ${id} but admission ${aid} belongs to unit ${other}

name: Record that they are away at an ED
does: Notes that an admitted patient has gone to an emergency department for a medical problem, while the ward keeps their bed.
needs: They are occupying a bed and are not already recorded away.
changes: Stamps the absence. No bed figure moves at all.

refuses.message: admission ${id} is already recorded as away at an emergency department

screen.control: Record that they have gone to an emergency department

name: Record that they are back
does: Notes that a patient who went to an emergency department is back on the ward, in the bed that was kept for them.
needs: They are currently recorded as away.
changes: Clears the absence.

refuses.message: admission ${id} is not recorded as away at an emergency department

screen.control: Record that they are back on the ward

name: Record a bed as on leave
does: Records that a bed is held for somebody on approved leave, with an expected return. It does not go back into circulation while they are away.
needs: The ward may only record it against itself.
changes: Creates the leave record.

refuses.message: RECORD_LEAVE_BED was raised acting as unit ${id} but targets unit ${other}

screen.control: Record leave bed (visible, but currently returns before dispatch)

name: End a bed's leave
does: Ends a bed's recorded leave period.
needs: The leave record exists and belongs to this ward.
changes: Removes the leave record.

refuses.message: END_LEAVE_BED was raised acting as unit ${id} but leave bed ${lid} belongs to unit ${other}

name: Flag a bed as coming free
does: A ward flags an upcoming discharge for a named occupying admission, saying when and what it is waiting on.
needs: The ward may only flag a stay on its own ward, with no other live release for that stay.
changes: Creates the bed release at “expected”.

refuses.when: A blocker not on the list
refuses.message: FLAG_BED_RELEASE blocker must be chosen from BED_RELEASE_BLOCKERS
FLAG_BED_RELEASE was raised acting as unit ${id} but targets unit ${other}

name: Confirm the discharge is going ahead
does: Confirms an expected discharge is now decided. It does not free the bed — that is a separate step.
needs: The release is currently expected.
changes: Moves it to confirmed and clears what it was waiting on. A stuck flag survives.

refuses.message: cannot move release ${id} from ${state} to confirmed

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Put a confirmed discharge back to expected
does: Reverses a confirmed discharge decision, restating what it is now waiting on. The only step of the three that goes backwards.
needs: The release is currently confirmed.
changes: Moves it back to expected with a stated wait.

refuses.message: cannot move release ${id} from ${state} to expected

refuses.when: A wait not on the list
refuses.message: REVERT_BED_RELEASE waitingOn must be chosen from BED_RELEASE_WAITING_ON

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Flag a discharge as stuck
does: Flags that a discharge — expected or confirmed — is currently stuck, and says why. Being stuck is a flag, not a stage.
needs: The bed has not already been released.
changes: Sets the blocker and who set it. The stage does not move.

refuses.message: cannot block release ${id} because it is already released
BLOCK_BED_RELEASE requires a blocker chosen from BED_RELEASE_BLOCKERS

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Clear the stuck flag
does: Clears the stuck flag once whatever was holding the discharge up has been resolved.
needs: There is a flag to clear.
changes: Clears it.

refuses.message: release ${id} carries no blocked flag to clear

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Mark a bed as being made ready
does: Marks a bed as being cleaned or awaiting repair. This is information only — it never stops the bed being counted as available or offered to somebody.
needs: The ward may only set it on its own release.
changes: Sets the note. No capacity figure moves.

refuses.when: A note not on the list
refuses.message: SET_BED_PREPARATION note must be chosen from BED_PREPARATION_NOTES

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Release the bed
does: Still in the engine, but no longer how a bed comes free. Since 26 September a release completes when the ward records its named patient leaving; this is refused while that person is still in the bed, and no screen sends it.
needs: The release has not already been discharged, and the patient it names has already left.
changes: Marks it discharged, clears every flag, and raises both the allocatable and the empty count by one.

refuses.message: no bed release found for id ${releaseId}

refuses.when: Its patient is still in the bed
refuses.message: release ${id} completes when admission ${admissionId} is recorded as having left (RECORD_LEAVING); they are still ${state}
release ${id} is already discharged and cannot be discharged again

refuses.when: Acting as a ward the release does not belong to
refuses.message: raised acting as one unit but the release belongs to another

name: Restate how many beds a ward has
does: A ward restates how many beds it can currently allocate. This does move a real bed count.
needs: The ward may only restate its own, with a current revision and a nonnegative whole number no greater than its bed count.
changes: Sets the allocatable figure, marks it as ward-sourced, and stamps the time.

refuses.message: CONFIRM_CAPACITY was raised acting as unit ${id} but targets unit ${other}

refuses.when: Claiming more beds than the ward has
refuses.message: says a unit can allocate more beds than it has

name: Record what is restricting a ward's intake
does: A ward records the restrictions it is currently operating under — staffing, infection control, a closed bay, and so on.
needs: The ward may only record its own.
changes: Replaces its constraint list.

refuses.when: A code not on the list
refuses.message: RECORD_WARD_INTAKE_CONSTRAINTS codes must all be chosen from WARD_INTAKE_CONSTRAINTS

name: Ask a ward to refresh its numbers
does: Records that somebody asked a ward to refresh its bed numbers. It changes no bed count itself.
needs: The ward exists.
changes: Logs the request.

refuses.message: no unit found for id ${unitId}

name: Change how urgent it is
does: Changes the urgency, recording who changed it and why. It triggers no re-sorting or re-referral on its own.
needs: The record is open.
changes: Sets the urgency and logs the change.

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: CHANGE_URGENCY reason must be chosen from URGENCY_CHANGE_REASONS

name: Flag it urgent
does: Marks the patient urgent so they sit above every urgency level in the coordinator's queue, recording who and why.
needs: The record is open and not already flagged.
changes: Sets the flag and opens a history entry.

refuses.message: movement ${id} is already flagged urgent

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: FLAG_MOVEMENT_URGENT reason must be chosen from URGENT_MARK_REASONS

name: Clear the urgent flag
does: Removes the urgent flag once it is no longer needed.
needs: It is currently flagged. Deliberately allowed even on a closed record.
changes: Clears the flag and closes the history entry.

refuses.message: movement ${id} is not flagged urgent

name: Say what is holding this up
does: Free text describing what is actually holding the patient up. The only free-text field of its kind in the engine.
needs: The record is open and the text is not blank.
changes: Replaces the blocker text.

refuses.message: RECORD_MOVEMENT_BLOCKER blocker must say something — a blank is not a statement

refuses.when: Text that differs from “nothing is blocking” only in capitals
refuses.message: “${blocker}” differs from “${nearMiss}” only in case, and would be stored as an active blocker — use CLEAR_MOVEMENT_BLOCKER to say nothing is holding this up

name: Say nothing is holding it up
does: Records that nothing is holding the patient up any more — which is a different statement from nobody ever having recorded one.
needs: The record is open and does not already say so.
changes: Writes “None — cleared”.

refuses.message: movement ${id} already records that nothing is holding it up

screen.control: Clear — nothing is holding this up

name: Mark a notice read
does: Marks a notice as read by the person or team it was actually addressed to.
needs: You are the addressee, exactly, and it is not already marked.
changes: Stamps who read it and when.

refuses.message: MARK_NOTICE_READ role/actingPlaceId must match notice ${id}'s own addressee
notice ${id} is already marked read

name: Acknowledge an inbox row
does: Records that the coordinator has seen a row and is on top of it, without removing or hiding it.
needs: The row names a real category and a real record.
changes: Logs the acknowledgement. Touches nothing else.

refuses.message: ACKNOWLEDGE_INBOX_ITEM inboxItemId must name a row — a blank names nothing

name: Tick off an inbox row
does: Ticks off a row that represents a task somebody must do. A row stating a live fact can never be ticked — it leaves the list when it stops being true.
needs: Real inbox rows are live facts and cannot be completed. The current guard accepts a fabricated commitment-prefixed ID without checking for a matching row.
changes: Logs completion for an accepted ID, even when no inbox row exists.

refuses.message: inbox row ${id} states a live fact, not a commitment — a fact leaves this list when it stops being true, never because it was ticked off
inbox row ${id} is already complete

screen.control: Mark done — built, but the list it sits in is always empty

name: Reopen a completed row
does: Undoes a completed row, while keeping the fact that it was once completed.
needs: It is currently complete.
changes: Logs the reopening.

refuses.message: inbox row ${id} is not complete, so there is nothing to reopen

screen.control: Reopen — built, but the list it sits in is always empty

name: Move the demonstration clock
does: Fast-forwards the demonstration clock. It is the only thing that moves time in this prototype — nothing here runs in real time.
needs: Nothing.
changes: Moves the clock offset.

name: Reset the board
does: Resets everything back to the standard starting scenario, keeping the clock where it is.
needs: Nothing.
changes: Replaces the whole state.

name: Switch to a different simulated night
does: Switches to a different pre-built simulated night, resetting every patient, ward and record.
needs: A recognised scenario.
changes: Replaces the whole state.

refuses.message: SET_SCENARIO scenario must be chosen from WARD_SCENARIOS

name: Change the coordinator's settings
does: Saves the tunable settings the rest of the system reads — access-time targets, the parallel referral cap, how long a bed hold lasts.
needs: The settings pass validation.
changes: Replaces the configuration.

refuses.message: (the validator supplies its own sentence naming the offending field)

name: Record a discharge (handled earlier)
does: Reaches a branch that does nothing. The real handling runs earlier, before this point is ever reached.
needs: Unreachable in normal use.
changes: Nothing.

name: Open a discharge record (handled earlier)
does: Reaches a branch that does nothing. The real handling runs earlier.
needs: Unreachable in normal use.
changes: Nothing.

screen.control: A patient's row in the discharge list

name: Review an audit entry (handled earlier)
does: Reaches a branch that does nothing. The real handling runs earlier.
needs: Unreachable in normal use.
changes: Nothing.

name: Divert a journey already under way
does: Records that a patient already in the vehicle was taken somewhere other than the ward expecting them, with a reason and the place they went.
needs: A transport job that has been collected, on a movement that is open, not arrived, not already stopped or cancelled, and not already diverted.
changes: Marks the movement diverted and records where the patient is. The held bed is NOT given back by this act.

refuses.when: Before the patient is in the vehicle
refuses.message: transport has not been collected yet; diversion is only for a journey already under way
movement ${id}'s patient has already arrived

refuses.when: The journey was already stopped or cancelled
refuses.message: movement ${id}'s transport was already stopped or cancelled
movement ${id} was already diverted

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: RECORD_DIVERSION reason must be chosen from DIVERSION_REASONS

name: Give back the bed a diverted patient was holding
does: Releases the bed still held for a movement that was diverted. Separate from the diversion itself, deliberately: diverting somebody does not decide what happens to their bed.
needs: A movement that really was diverted, and that still holds a bed.
changes: Returns the bed to the ward's figures.

refuses.message: movement ${id} was not diverted, so there is no diverted bed to release this way
movement ${id} holds no bed — it may already have been released

refuses.when: A ward acting on another ward's bed
refuses.message: RELEASE_DIVERTED_BED was raised acting as unit ${id} but movement ${mid}'s bed is held elsewhere

name: Record how and when they are expected
does: Records the way the patient is travelling, any tracking number, and the time they are expected.
needs: A movement.
changes: Stores those three details on the movement and clears any pull-expiry timer. Moves no stage and reserves nothing.

refuses.message: no movement found for id ${id}

name: Work out whether an expected arrival is late
does: Compares the expected arrival time against the clock and records whether it has passed.
needs: A movement, and a role allowed to ask.
changes: When late, stamps the movement and sends notices to the emergency department and ward. When on time, leaves it unchanged. No journey stage moves.

refuses.when: A role not permitted to ask
refuses.message: ${type} requires role ${roles}

name: Mark somebody as a step-down candidate
does: Records that this admission could move to a lower level of care.
needs: An admission.
changes: Sets the flag, and nothing else. No bed figure moves.

name: Record what is holding a discharge up
does: Records the single thing in the way of this discharge, or that nothing is.
needs: A known admission on the acting ward; a substantive barrier requires a stay of at least seven days.
changes: Sets that one value. It is a note, not a gate — nothing reads it to decide anything.

name: Set or move the expected discharge date
does: Sets when this admission is expected to leave. Moving a date already set counts as one more move.
needs: An admission that has not already left. A ward can only set it for its own patients.
changes: Sets the expected discharge time, counts the move, and stamps when it was set. It names "Ward manager" as the setter only when a ward set it; a coordinator's change records no setter.

refuses.message: no admission found for id ${admissionId}
cannot update expected discharge for departed admission ${admissionId}

refuses.when: A ward changing another ward's patient
refuses.message: UPDATE_EXPECTED_DISCHARGE was raised acting as unit ${actingUnitId} but admission ${id} belongs to unit ${unitId}
UPDATE_EXPECTED_DISCHARGE expectedDischargeAt must be a valid timestamp

name: Record care journey fact
does: Records a care journey fact (such as a transfer, transport, clinical plan or document) against an admission on the discharge board.
needs: An occupied or departed admission with linked identity matching the expected revision.
changes: Appends or updates the care journey record. Moves no bed figure.

name: Record follow-up arrangement
does: Records follow-up contact arrangements against an admission on the discharge board.
needs: An occupied or departed admission with linked identity matching the expected revision.
changes: Updates the follow-up arrangement on the admission. Moves no bed figure.

name: Record medical clearance against the movement
does: Records whether this patient is medically cleared — on the MOVEMENT. The referral carries its own separate answer, and the two are not joined.
needs: A movement.
changes: Stores the answer. Overwritable.

refuses.message: no movement found for id ${id}

name: Attach a file to the movement
does: Records that a document was attached, by name and size.
needs: A movement.
changes: Adds the file's NAME to the record. The file itself is not modelled or stored anywhere in this prototype.

refuses.message: no movement found for id ${id}

name: Record that a legal form was written
does: Records which form was written, with typed start and expiry times.
needs: An open movement, a supported form and valid typed times; 3C cannot follow arrival on 3D.
changes: Stores the paper form and its typed expiry, and clears the old legal clock.

refuses.message: cannot record a written form for a closed movement

refuses.when: A form with no clock here
refuses.message: Form ${code} has no legal clock in this prototype

refuses.when: A 3C for somebody who arrived on a 3D
refuses.message: Form 3C is refused when the person arrived on a Form 3D

name: Record that a form was continued
does: Records a continuation with typed times. A 5B continues a 5A; other supported forms can replace paper facts without a prior form.
needs: An open movement, supported form and valid typed start and expiry times.
changes: Stores the paper form and typed expiry, and clears the old legal clock.

refuses.when: A form with no clock here
refuses.message: Form ${code} has no legal clock in this prototype

name: Country extension request (always refused)
does: This old extension event is always refused; record a typed expiry with RECORD_LEGAL_FORM_EXPIRY instead.
needs: No state can make this event succeed.
changes: Nothing.

refuses.when: Any country-extension request for an existing movement
refuses.message: country extensions are recorded as a typed expiry — use RECORD_LEGAL_FORM_EXPIRY with the new expiry written on the form

name: Flag that the ward's authority does not match
does: Records one of two mismatches: an involuntary patient on a voluntary ward, or a voluntary patient on a locked one.
needs: A movement and a real unit.
changes: Raises the flag. It does not stop anything by itself.

refuses.message: no movement found for id ${id}
no unit found for id ${id}

name: Start a forty-eight-hour or seven-day clock by hand
does: Raises one of two hand-set clocks against a movement.
needs: A movement with no such flag already open.
changes: Records the flag. Nothing starts it automatically and nothing expires it.

refuses.message: movement ${id} already has an open expect flag

name: Clear that hand-set clock
does: Clears the flag raised above.
needs: A movement with one open.
changes: Removes the flag.

refuses.message: movement ${id} has no open expect flag to clear

name: Give the bed back and reopen the search, in one act
does: Releases the held bed AND puts the movement back into the bed search together, rather than as two separate steps.
needs: An open movement with a held bed, no booked transport, the holding ward acting and a reason from the release list. Cancel transport first if booked.
changes: Returns the bed and sends the movement back to the search.

refuses.message: cannot release and reopen a closed movement
cannot release and reopen at the movement's current stage

refuses.when: A reason not on the list
refuses.message: RELEASE_AND_REOPEN_SEARCH reason must be chosen from RELEASE_PULL_REASONS

refuses.when: A ward acting on another ward's bed
refuses.message: RELEASE_AND_REOPEN_SEARCH was raised acting as unit ${id} but the bed is held elsewhere

screen.control: Release held bed and reopen search

name: Confirm the ward's morning count
does: A ward confirming how many discharges it expects that morning.
needs: The acting ward must match the target; the count must be a nonnegative safe integer.
changes: Records the confirmed number against the ward.

name: Send a message to a ward
does: Sends a short message to a ward, optionally marked urgent.
needs: A unit. The engine also accepts a blank message.
changes: Records the message. It belongs to no patient.

name: Sweep the beds held during leave
does: Works out which beds being held while somebody is on leave are worth warning about.
needs: Nothing but the clock — it takes no patient and no ward.
changes: Records the warnings it worked out.

name: Log a repatriation arranged by phone
does: Logs a repatriation already arranged off the system: the home hospital, whether its ward agreed, road or flight, the provider, the CAD or tracking number, voluntary or involuntary, and an estimated time. It books nothing.
needs: An admission with no repatriation already logged, and every answer given. None has a default.
changes: Keeps the log entry. Only if the home ward agreed, it also opens a new return movement at placement requested, so a bed can be found at home.

refuses.message: no admission found for id ${id}
admission ${id} already has a repatriation record

refuses.when: A home hospital that does not exist
refuses.message: RECORD_REPATRIATION homeHospital ${code} does not name a real site

refuses.when: Whether the ward agreed left blank
refuses.message: RECORD_REPATRIATION receivingWardAgreed must be answered, and it has no default
RECORD_REPATRIATION mode must be chosen from REPATRIATION_MODES

refuses.when: A provider not on the list
refuses.message: RECORD_REPATRIATION provider must be chosen from TRANSPORT_PROVIDERS
RECORD_REPATRIATION cadNumber must be answered, and it has no default
RECORD_REPATRIATION transportLegalStatus must be chosen from TRANSPORT_LEGAL_STATUSES
RECORD_REPATRIATION estimatedAt must be answered, and it has no default

name: Sign off the shift handover
does: Records that the shift handover was signed off.
needs: Nothing beyond the role.
changes: Stores the role and the time only. Never a note, a name, or a claim that the sheet was sent to anyone.

name: Record that a team was contacted
does: Records that somebody contacted a community team. This is the contact itself, not a message sent through the system.
needs: A community team that exists.
changes: Stores the team, the time and the role.

refuses.when: A team that does not exist
refuses.message: RECORD_CLINICAL_CONTACT teamId ${id} does not name a real team

name: Send a network-wide alert
does: Sends an alert to wards and emergency departments across the network, with a severity, a category, who it is aimed at and how long it lasts.
needs: A nonblank title and message, valid severity, category and scope, and a positive finite duration when supplied.
changes: Adds the alert as active, with nobody yet acknowledging it. It belongs to no patient.

refuses.message: DISPATCH_BROADCAST_ALERT requires a non-empty title and message

name: Acknowledge a network-wide alert
does: Records that one ward or desk has seen a network-wide alert.
needs: An active alert and a known unit that has not acknowledged it already. Duplicate acknowledgement is refused.
changes: Adds the unit to the alert's acknowledged list.

refuses.message: ACKNOWLEDGE_BROADCAST_ALERT alertId ${id} not found

screen.control: Acknowledge (global banner currently acts as coordinator desk)

name: Stand down a network-wide alert
does: Ends a network-wide alert once the pressure has passed.
needs: An alert that exists and has not already been stood down.
changes: Marks the alert stood down, with the time and who did it.

refuses.message: STAND_DOWN_BROADCAST_ALERT alertId ${id} not found
